stories.title: Our guide to every NFL Week 4 game: Matchup previews, predictions, picks and nuggets
stories.summary: Trevor Lawrence vs. Joe Burrow. New England looking to bounce back. There are 15 more games this week, and we have picks, predictions and more for all of them.

stories.title: Make pass interference reviewable? 17 NFL coaches debate
stories.summary: It's been tried once before and some coaches want to bring it back, but others want to keep status quo.

stories.title: Commanders' Daniels again ruled out; Mariota to start vs. Colts
stories.summary: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels was ruled out of Sunday's game vs. the Colts, causing him to miss a second consecutive game because of a dislocated left elbow.

stories.title: Braves break out 'warrior' Sale to close out Phils in wild-card clincher
stories.summary: On one day of rest, Braves ace Chris Sale turned in an electric four-out relief appearance to finish the Phillies in a 6-2 win Thursday night in the deciding Game 3 of their wild-card series.

stories.title: Watson puts 3-1 Browns atop North after leading third straight winning drive
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson has the Browns atop the division at 3-1 after directing a winning drive for the third straight game Thursday night in a 27-24 win over the Steelers.
